lines.en: Well, Gladys, say hello to your new home.
Wow. Oh, she is so nice and big.
Oh, Monica, where are you going to display Gladys oh-so-proudly?
You haven't really settled on a spot yet.
Well, hey, how about right above the TV?
That way, it will be the first thing that you see
when you walk in the door.
Yeah, yeah, and you can get rid of that French poster.
Doesn't have anything coming out of it.
Or maybe there's someplace far in your bedroom.
Oh, there's nothing above your bed.
